Damaged items are not handled differently from a normal return. The process remains the same, as outlined below:

Contact us to let us know you wish to return your mattress.
We will request images of the mattress, including the fire tag and the full surface of the mattress. These images help us ensure the mattress is in a suitable condition to be donated to charity.
Once the images are reviewed, we will facilitate arranging a pick-up date with your nearest collection partner.
After the mattress is picked up by the collection partner, we will process your refund back to your original payment method.

This process typically takes around 10–15 working days. If the damage is significant, please ensure the images clearly show the issue so we can proceed accordingly. Let me know if you need further clarification or assistance!

The returns process for DreamCloud mattresses is designed to provide a refund rather than a replacement. Here’s how it works:

Contact us to let us know you wish to return your mattress.
We will request images of the mattress, including the fire tag and the full surface of the mattress. These images help us ensure the mattress is in a suitable condition to be donated to charity.
Once the images are reviewed, we will facilitate arranging a pick-up date with your nearest collection partner.
After the mattress is picked up by the collection partner, we will process your refund back to your original payment method.

This process typically takes around 10–15 working days. If you have any further questions or concerns, feel free to ask!
